meta.title: Tutlayt d Tira Tipunikiyen — Agemmay Afiniqi, Tira ɣef Yiẓra, Idlisen Yeruḥen
meta.desc: Agemmay afiniqi n 22 isekkilen, seg tpunikt ar tneopunikt, tira ɣef yiẓra (tofet, lexraj n Marseille, Pyrgi, Dougga), tsekla n Qarṭaǧ i yeruḥen akked wagla-ines. Aru isem-ik/ik s tfiniqit.
hero.title: Tutlayt d Tira Tipunikiyen
hero.lede: Sin uɛecrin isekkilen, ttwarun seg uyeffus ɣer uzelmaḍ : agemmay i d-yusan seg Finiqya yewwi tutlayt n Qarṭaǧ leqrun aṭas — yerna seg-s i d-yekka wagemmay-nneɣ.
hero.wordText: Qart-ḥadasht, « Tamdint Tamaynut » : isem n Qarṭaǧ akken i t-ttarun imezdaɣ-is, war isekkilen n uɛeqqa.
stats.0.t: isekkilen, akk d wid ur nesɛi uɛeqqa : agemmay afiniqi
stats.1.t: asekkil n uɛeqqa i d-yettwarun deg tira tafiniqit taqdimt
stats.2.t: uq.Ɛ. : azru n usekkil n Nora, lqern wis 9–8 (Sardaigne), yiwen seg tira tifiniqiyin tiqburin aktar n Lɣarb
stats.3.t: dffr Ɛ. : agellid Augustin mazal yesla i tutlayt tapunikt deg lexla
abc.title: Agemmay Afiniqi
abc.intro: Yal asekkil yesɛa isem n wawal i ibdan yis. Lmeɛna n ismawen-agi d tansayt ; i kra deg-sen, mazal-itt d tabaḥart.
abc.note: Ddaw yal asekkil : tira s tira n umassan, lmeɛna tansayt n yisem, syen asekkil agrigi i d-yekkan deg-s, asekkil alatini i d-yeṭṭfen deg-s (ma yella), akked wesekkil aɛrab i t-yemsalayen. Alugen aqdim n wegemmay aɛrab — abjad, hawwaz, ḥuṭṭī… — mazal-it yeṭṭaf win n Yifiniqiyen.
w.title: Aru Isem-ik/ik s Tfiniqit
w.lede: Sekcem isem (s isekkilen ilatiniyen neɣ iɛrabiyen) : yal imesli ad t-id-yerr asekkil afiniqi iqeṛben akter.
w.label: Isem-ik/ik
w.note: D amedya n urar kan : agemmay afiniqi ur yesɛi ara isekkilen n uɛeqqa yerna kra n yimesliyen ur llin ara (v, j, é…). Hannibal n tidet yettwara
w.note2: (Ḥnbʿl, « laḥnana n Baal »), seg uyeffus ɣer uzelmaḍ.
lang.title: Seg Tfiniqit ɣer Tpunikt, syen ɣer Tneopunikt
lang.rows.0.val: Azru n usekkil n Nora, di Sardaigne, isban-d tira tafiniqit tebna yakan deg Lebḥer Alemmas Alɣarbi.
lang.rows.1.val: Tapunikt, tafiniqit n Lɣarb, tuɣal d tutlayt tamatut n umaḍal aqarṭaǧi, s tɣuri-ines tamaynut yesɛan afaris n tutlayt tilibit (Lancel).
lang.rows.2.val: Tigeldiwin tinumidiyin ṭṭfent-tt d tutlayt n udabu : ssekka-nsent sɛant tirawin tipunikiyin (Lancel).
lang.rows.3.val: Aɣelluy n Qarṭaǧ ur yesseɣli ara tutlayt. Tira « tineopunikt », tuɣalin aktar, teqqar-d tura kra n isekkilen n uɛeqqa ; mazal-ten ttwaɣran tira ɣef yiẓra deg lqern wis 1 akked wis 2 dffr Ɛ.
lang.rows.4.val: Ttarun tapunikt s isekkilen ilatiniyen (Lancel) : agemmay ibeddel, tutlayt teqqim.
aug.quote: « Steqsit ifellaḥen-nneɣ ɣef wacu llan : ttarran-d s tutlayt tapunikt “Chanani”. »
aug.cite: Augustin, Epistolae ad Romanos inchoata expositio, 13
aug.nuance: Aḍris-agi yettwabder aṭas d ccahada belli tapunikt mazal-itt ttwamesl, yerna wid i tt-yemmeslayen qqaṛen-d iman-nsen « Ayt Canaan ». Maca aḍris d aḍris n lexṭaba, tizmilin-is mgaraden gar-asent ; Gabriel Camps iwala deg-s ahat awal alibi, imi punicus yeɛni aṭas tikwal « afriqan » deg wakud-nni.
subst.text: I Stéphane Gsell, syen i M'hamed Hassine Fantar, tudert n tutlayt tasamit di Tefriqt Ugafa tzemer ad tsellek, leqrun deffir, taɛrabt n Legrib.
ins.title: Ayen d-qqaṛen Iẓra
ins.intro: War idlisen, tira ɣef yiẓra d tɣbula tamezwarut yuran. Llant aṭas, maca aṭas n tikwal d tiwezlanin yerna ttɛawadent.
ins.tophet.title: Iẓra n Usekkil n Tofet
ins.tophet.alt: Azru n usekkil apunik s ssuma n Tanit
ins.tophet.caption: Azru n usekkil s ssuma n Tanit, Amuzgan n Louvre
ins.tophet.p1: Tofetat n Qarṭaǧ akked temdinin-nniḍen fkant-d uḍan deg-sent, sdukklen deg Corpus Inscriptionum Semiticarum. Tira-nsent tettɛawad aṭas : ur d-fkant ara aṭas ɣef umezruy n temdint d drus kan n ismawen.
ins.tophet.formula: « I Tsekkurt Tanit, udem n Baal, akked Ssid Baal Hammon » : awal n usbegges i yeldin aṭas seg iẓra n usekkil n Qarṭaǧ.
ins.tophet.p2a: Ɣef yiṛebbiten-agi akked umgired ɣef tofet, wali asebter
ins.cards.0.title: Lexraj n Marseille
ins.cards.0.text: Yettwaf deg webeḥri n Marseille, alugen-agi isbedd, lxayun s lxayun, amur i yeqqnen i lkahnin i yal asfel. Imassanen qqaṛen-d yusa-d seg Qarṭaǧ.
ins.cards.1.title: Tefyirin n Pyrgi
ins.cards.1.text: Tlata n yifer n ddheb ttwafen di 1964 deg webeḥri n Caere : sin s tirusikt, yiwet s tfiniqit. Agellid Thefarie Velianas yebges-d deg-sen amkan iqedsen i Uni-Astarté.
ins.cards.2.title: Snat Tutlayin n Dougga
ins.cards.2.text: Ɣef uẓekka alibikubunik n Dougga, yiwen uḍris s tpunikt akked tlibit — tasarut i tɣuri n tira tilibit. Lǧer-agi yettwakkes di 1842 sɣur lqunsul abriṭani Thomas Reade.
ins.cards.3.title: Isekkilen n Uzzal
ins.cards.3.text: Tirawin n ssekka, tipunikiyin syen tinumidiyin, d tira daɣen : sskanent-d amek talɣa n isekkilen tettbeddil s imukan d wakud.
lit.title: Tikaṭebin war Idlisen
lit.p1: Qarṭaǧ tesɛa tikaṭebin, anda teddukel tsekla tagrikit daɣen. Ttarun-d deg-sent ɣef ddustur, amezruy, tussna n tmurt ; imussnawen iqarṭaǧiyen ttwassnen sɣur Diogène Laërce akked Jamblique.
lit.p2: Di 146, akken i d-yeqqaṛ Pline, Asqamu aṛumi yefka tikaṭebin-agi i yigelliden inumidiyen yerna isuqel kan Magon. Salluste yeqqaṛ-d yeɣra « idlisen ipunikiyen » yettwaḥesben d wayla n ugellid Hiempsal ; syen, ṛuḥen.
lit.src: Pline, Amezruy n Tgama, XVIII, 22 · Salluste, Amennuɣ n Jugurtha, 17
lit.works.0.val: Adlis n tfellaḥt s 28 yidlisen, d yiwen n wedlis apunik kan i yettwasuqlen ɣer talatinit s lameṛ n Usqamu ; yettwassen sɣur Varron, Columelle d Pline.
lit.works.1.val: Tiqsiṭ n ubrid-is tewweḍ-d ɣer-neɣ s tegrikt, d asuqel n uḍris apunik i d-ibanen deg uxxam n ssjada ; lefhem-ines mazal-it d asteqsi.
lit.works.2.val: Ilul di Qarṭaǧ s yisem n Hasdrubal, iḥekkem ɣef Tasdawit n Platon di Athènes deg lqern wis 2 uq.Ɛ. — maca yura s tegrikt.
lit.works.3.val: Amezruy, ddustur, tussna n tmurt : tira-agi ur d-yeqqim ara deg-sent ala drus n wawalen n yimeskaren igrikiyen d yilatiniyen.
her.title: Agemmay i Yeṭṭfen Amaḍal
her.intro: Igrigen seqdacen agemmay n Yifiniqiyen rnan-as isekkilen n uɛeqqa. Seg-sen, syen seg Yitrusk d Iṛumaniyen, yuɣal d wegemmay-nneɣ.

her.evo.caption: Timsizdikin gar isekkilen ifiniqiyen, igrikiyen d yilatiniyen
her.evo.note: Igrigen rran d isekkilen n uɛeqqa kra n yimesliyen ur nelli ara deg tutlayt-nsen : ʾālep tuɣal d alpha (A), ʿayin tuɣal d omicron (O).
